TextFormat.FontStyle allows to turn on Bold and/or Italic emulation
on a regular (not a bold/italic) font.
Regular Times font: Times New Roman
Bold emulation using font: Times New Roman
Italic emulation using font: Times New Roman
Bold+Italic emulation using font: Times New Roman
Using real bold font: Times New Roman Bold
Using real italic font: Times New Roman Italic
Using real bold italic font: Times New Roman Bold Italic
